SELECT c.company_id, c.company_name, c.logo_url, c.short_description,
ROUND(AVG(cr.overall_rating), 1) AS averageRating, COUNT(cr.company_review_id) AS reviewCount, MAX(cr.summary) AS summary,
CASE WHEN COUNT(jp.job_posting_id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hasJobPosting
FROM companies c
LEFT JOIN company_reviews cr ON c.company_id = cr.company_id AND cr.status = '정상'
LEFT JOIN job_postings jp ON c.company_id = jp.company_id AND jp.status = '모집중'
GROUP BY c.company_id, c.company_name, c.logo_url, c.short_description
ORDER BY hasJobPosting DESC, averageRating DESC, reviewCount DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT c.company_id, c.company_name, c.logo_url, c.industry_name, c.address_line1, c.short_description,
ROUND(AVG(cr.overall_rating), 1) AS averageRating, COUNT(cr.company_review_id) AS reviewCount, MAX(cr.summary) AS summary,
CASE WHEN COUNT(jp.job_posting_id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hasJobPosting
FROM companies c
LEFT JOIN company_reviews cr ON c.company_id = cr.company_id AND cr.status = '정상'
LEFT JOIN job_postings jp ON c.company_id = jp.company_id AND jp.status = '모집중'
LEFT JOIN job_categories jc ON jp.job_category_id = jc.job_category_id
( c.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.short_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.industry_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND c.industry_name = #{industry}
AND c.address_line1 LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%')
AND c.company_size = #{companySize}
AND jc.category_name = #{jobCategory}
GROUP BY c.company_id, c.company_name, c.logo_url, c.industry_name, c.address_line1, c.short_description
ORDER BY hasJobPosting DESC, averageRating DESC, reviewCount DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT DISTINCT industry_name FROM companies WHERE industry_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY industry_name
SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX(address_line1, ' ', 1) AS region FROM companies WHERE address_line1 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY region;
SELECT DISTINCT company_size FROM companies WHERE company_size IS NOT NULL ORDER BY company_size
SELECT job_category_id, category_name FROM job_categories ORDER BY category_name

SELECT
c.company_id, c.company_name, c.logo_url, c.industry_name, c.company_size, c.established_date, c.address_line1, c.homepage_url, c.short_description, c.introduction, c.benefits, c.employee_count,
ROUND(AVG(cr.overall_rating),1) AS averageRating, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.company_review_id) AS reviewCount, COUNT(DISTINCT jp.job_posting_id) AS jobPostingCount
FROM companies c
LEFT JOIN company_reviews cr ON c.company_id = cr.company_id AND cr.status='정상'
LEFT JOIN job_postings jp ON c.company_id = jp.company_id AND jp.status='모집중'
WHERE c.company_id = #{companyId}
GROUP BY c.company_id, c.company_name, c.logo_url, c.industry_name, c.company_size, c.established_date, c.address_line1, c.homepage_url, c.short_description, c.introduction, c.benefits, c.employee_count

SELECT job_posting_id, title, work_region, apply_end_at, DATEDIFF(apply_end_at, CURDATE()) AS dday FROM job_postings
WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status = '모집중'
ORDER BY apply_end_at ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT jp.job_posting_id, jp.company_id, jp.title, jp.career_type, jp.min_experience_years, jp.max_experience_years, jp.work_region, jp.education_level, jp.salary_text, jp.apply_end_at,
DATEDIFF(jp.apply_end_at, CURDATE()) AS dday,
c.company_name, c.logo_url
FROM job_postings jp
INNER JOIN companies c ON jp.company_id = c.company_id
WHERE jp.company_id = #{companyId} AND jp.status = '모집중'
ORDER BY jp.apply_end_at ASC

SELECT s.skill_name
FROM job_posting_skills jps
JOIN skills s ON jps.skill_id = s.skill_id
WHERE jps.job_posting_id = #{jobPostingId}
ORDER BY s.display_order
